import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static Map<String, Long> allMap = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<String, Long> limitMap = new HashMap<>();
    static int n, m;

    public static long searchall(int lo, int hi) {
        if (lo == hi) {
            return 1;
        }
        String key = lo + "," + hi;
        if (allMap.containsKey(key)) {
            return allMap.get(key);
        }
        
        long res = 0;
        res += searchall(lo + 1, hi);
        res += searchall(lo, hi - 1);
        for (int i = lo + 1; i < hi; i++) {
            res += searchall(lo, i - 1) * searchall(i + 1, hi);
        }
        allMap.put(key, res);
        return res;
    }

    public static long searchlimit(int lo, int hi, int depth) {
        if (lo == hi) {
            return (depth < m) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        String key = lo + "," + hi + "," + depth;
        if (limitMap.containsKey(key)) {
            return limitMap.get(key);
        }

        long res = 0;
        res += searchlimit(lo + 1, hi, depth + 1);
        res += searchlimit(lo, hi - 1, depth + 1);
        for (int i = lo + 1; i < hi; i++) {
            res += searchlimit(lo, i - 1, depth + 1) * searchlimit(i + 1, hi, depth + 1);
        }
        limitMap.put(key, res);
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {

            }

}
